author: researcher
claim: Google Health (the former Fitbit app) help says its weekly sleep view shows the hours slept each night that week together with a weekly average.
subject: Google Health (Fitbit)
limitations: Help-centre text, not observed in the app. The page does not say which day the week starts, whether it is a calendar week or the last 7 days, or how nights without data affect the average. The page says the feature may require a Premium subscription.
